title: Google Ads Tips for Florists: Boost Your Flower Shop Sales | BoostFloral

facts.fact: The BoostFloral blog post 'Using Google Ads to Market Your Flower Shop Website' is dated January 28, 2024.
The page recommends Target CPA (Cost Per Acquisition) as an automated bidding strategy for optimizing bids.
facts.quote: Use automated bidding strategies like Target CPA (Cost Per Acquisition) to optimize your bids for the best results.

facts.fact: The page recommends tracking click-through rate (CTR), conversion rate, and return on ad spend (ROAS) in Google Analytics and Google Ads reports.
facts.quote: Track Performance:** Use Google Analytics and Google Ads reports to keep an eye on how your campaigns are doing. Look at metrics like click-through rate (CTR), conversion rate, and return on ad spend (ROAS).

facts.fact: The page advises using Google Keyword Planner to find keywords related to a flower business.
facts.quote: Start by using Google Keyword Planner to find keywords related to your business.
